description: This file defines a class responsible for transforming 'background' attributes in HTML to inline CSS styles, specifically converting proprietary background attributes into CSS background-image styles.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Background
classes.description: A class that transforms the 'background' attribute in HTML elements into CSS background-image styles.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the 'background' attribute into a CSS style 'background-image' by extracting the attribute and prepending the CSS rule.
